css_profile.quote: In order to apply for need-based scholarships, you must submit the College Scholarship Service (CSS) Profile or the ISFAA (International Student Financial Aid Application).

interview.quote: Vanderbilt does not offer interviews through the Office of Undergraduate Admissions.

counselor_rec.quote: School Report with the Counselor Recommendation and High School Transcript: To be completed and sent by your school counselor.

english.quote: If English is not the primary language of instruction in the secondary school(s) you have attended for the last three years, you must submit English language proficiency exam results.

portfolio.quote: If you have a well-developed talent or significant accomplishment in music, art, or dance, you may submit a portfolio to be evaluated by our faculty.
